notes_for_editor: Only a listing, a map location and an OpenStreetMap tag were found. No build date, builder, staffing, fires or current condition in any source. Elevation: TopoQuest gives 98 ft MSL (about 30 m); the tnlandforms list gives 95 with no unit labelled. The unit was inferred as feet from the Sunset entry, which matches TopoZone's 194 ft. The brief's elevation_m of 29.0 matches the 95 figure. Not on the Wikipedia list (which calls itself incomplete), NHLR or FFLOS. The story is about 100 words, below the roughly 120-word guide for thin evidence, because the sources support no more; the editor may hold or drop it.
